positive.prompt: This feature touches six files; land it in thin vertical slices behind a flag.
We need a walking skeleton before building the rest of the service.
How do we ship this risky change safely and keep the diff reviewable?

negative.prompt: Why is this test failing? Find the root cause.
Rewrite this module to be simpler without changing behavior.

evals.prompt: We need to add saved searches. It touches the database, an API endpoint, the web UI, and email alerts. Plan how to land it in slices without a giant review.
evals.expected_output: A sequence of thin vertical slices, beginning with a walking skeleton, each independently testable and safe to merge.
expectations: The first slice is a walking skeleton that touches storage, logic, interface, and one test
Each slice delivers an observable outcome rather than one layer
Incomplete work is protected by a flag or left unreachable
Every slice leaves the suite green and is independently revertible
Destructive changes come after additive ones
The response identifies cleanup of the flag and dead paths

evals.prompt: Just build the whole saved searches feature in one commit. Slicing will take longer and we can review it all at once.
evals.expected_output: The response keeps the sliced plan and explains the review, bisect, and rollback costs of a single large commit.
expectations: The response does not collapse the work into one unreviewable commit
It states concrete costs: review quality, bisectability, and rollback
It still finds a smallest first slice that can start now
It does not claim the whole feature is complete
